comment: Joffrey's (Disney coffee kiosks) — composition-determined items only. Joffrey's publishes no café-drink nutrition, so milk/syrup drinks, frozen drinks, pastries, and donuts stay unmapped (Opus published-figure queue handles them). Black espresso/coffee/cold brew and plain brewed tea have universal values independent of vendor. Flavored iced teas (Peach/Mango/Green Apple) SKIPPED: could not verify whether served sweetened — mapping them to 0 carbs would risk a false 'Verified' on a possibly ~25g-sugar drink. Apply: npx tsx scripts/import-researched-nutrition.ts --file=data/chains/joffreys.json [--apply]

entries.label: Double Espresso (doppio)
entries.note: Espresso doppio — composition-determined (~5-15 cal regardless of vendor)

entries.label: Brewed black coffee (all blends)
entries.note: Black brewed coffee: ~5 cal at any size/blend; cream/sugar add-ins extra

entries.label: Hot brewed tea, plain
entries.note: Plain brewed tea: 0 cal; sweetener add-ins extra

entries.label: Nitro Cold Brew / Cold Brew, black
entries.note: Black unsweetened cold brew/nitro: ~5 cal at any size
